author: FallTimeSummer
body:
Okay, so I'll probably get slammed again, and I guess that's understandable. And most of the mods are fine, and most people won't have a problem with them.

But as an active chatter, one or two of the mods are giving me infractions for simple things such as simply saying "FISSSSHHH" (which you all know I say a lot because I find it amusing whether you do) that I said as a joke and immediately got an infraction for "Watch the Caps!" This was only the other day. Then today, I got told off when I was just playing around and said "idiots :D" which I know a lot of people say anyway, and do they get told off? Not usually. Is it just me?

Its not really that fair. I kind of find it discriminating and stuff. To me it seems like they're kind of abusing their powers. And you expect me to obey that? (Don't take that seriously, its a joke TO ALL YOU MODS OUT THERE)

It's kind of ruining my fun... I mean, it's not like I'm trolling people.

Am I so smexy you must use everything you can to take me down? :D jk jk

~Ellz the Fish~

If you said "idiots :D" I can see why you might get a verbal warning to be respectful or whatever as even if it IS a joke, it may not come across like that through text. 

You really seem seem to be misusing or simply not understanding the verb to "discriminate" . No one is discriminating agaisn't you. Everyone be they black white Asian, sheep, fish, or cactus are all treated the same and if you are deemed to be breaking the rules than yes, like in real life, you get punished.

Maybe instead of blaming the staff, who I admit can be too strict sometimes, look at yourself and don't give them a reason to punish you. Learn from your infractions.

also as always if you do think a staff member is being too strict or abusive then simply report it to support@avicus.net as has been said.
